ruling: docs/CODEBOOK-NAMING-GRAMMAR.md §8.4a (role umbrella) + §6b (per-shape axes). Captain-ratified 2026-08-02. Members hand-verified line by line; 20 of 39 held, see docs/ROLE-SHAPES-2026-08-02.md

rule:create-token-role-attached-to-own-c.definition: A spell creates a Role token attached to a target creature its controller controls. Role type is a parameter, not axis identity (§8.4a). Unmarked delivery = spell ability (§1, CR 113.3a).

rule:etb-create-token-role-attached-to-o.definition: When the permanent enters, a triggered ability creates a Role token attached to a target creature its controller controls. Role type is a parameter (§8.4a).

rule:etb-create-token-role-attached-to-s.definition: When the permanent enters, a triggered ability creates a Role token attached to the SOURCE ITSELF, enchanting the creature that just entered. Distinct from the -own-creature sibling: the printed text says 'attached to it', not 'attached to target creature you control' (§6a).
